6213401.why: R-1 TARNBROOK, registered 12 November 2020: the section 8 window ran from 12 November 2025 to 12 November 2026 and is open (rules: windows). Backpacks and duffel bags (class 18) and camp mugs (class 21) are all sold this month; specimens SP-01 or SP-03 and SP-04 are real photographs and a live product page, not the SP-02 render. Section 8 only, 2 classes at 325 dollars: 650. Sales under it, 18,400 dollars

5100288.why: R-2 TARNBROOK TRAIL, registered 2 December 2016: the ten-year point is 2 December 2026 and the window opened 2 December 2025, so a section 8 and section 9 renewal are filed together, in 2 classes. Gloves were discontinued on 14 February 2023 (D-2, Storeline P-07) and are deleted in the filing, not declared; deleted inside the filing there is no 250 dollar fee. Fees: 2 classes at 325 for section 8 and 325 for renewal, 1,300. Sales under it, 11,200 dollars

5011974.why: R-3 TARNBROOK ROCK, registered 14 April 2016: the ten-year point was 14 April 2026, so the deadline has passed and the 6-month grace period runs to 14 October 2026, five days from now. Knit caps are sold this week. Section 8 and section 9 with both grace surcharges for the one class: 325 + 325 + 100 + 100 = 850. Sales under it, 9,600 dollars

6075522.why: R-4 TARNBROOK logo, registered 9 June 2020: the sixth anniversary was 9 June 2026, so the section 8 deadline has passed and the grace period runs to 9 December 2026. Wool socks are sold this month. Section 8 with the grace surcharge for the one class: 325 + 100 = 425. Sales under it, 6,300 dollars
